column1: # The radiation that slice migration adds to the keep mode under the quiet start, the record
# mig-keep-measured of docs/migration.md. Measured on 2026-11-24 on examples/import with the release
# build of Lucifer at commit b6392a4 (the former placement of the copies) and with the same source in
# which keep_initial_state returns each copy to the wavelength of its particle (the present placement),
# gfortran 15.3.0, Bmad 20261122-0, four threads. The quiet runs set beam.shot_noise=false
# run.migrate=true and the SASE runs run.migrate=false, each at run.ran_seed 12345 to 12352 and at the
# window.n_wavelength of the first column. The second column is the step in undulator periods: 3 is
# the ds_step = 0.045 of UND in examples/aramis.bmad, and 1 is that lattice with ds_step = 0.015.
# Each row is the end of an undulator. An energy is the pulse energy, the energy of the field in the
# window with the energy that has left it. A mean is over the eight seeds and se is its standard
# error. A ratio is taken seed by seed and then averaged. The columns are separated by tabs.
